info.title: Customer Return (A2X)
info.description:
In every API call, you can use the following operations:
 - You can retrieve returns orders. Apply any of the filters provided or retrieve all existing data.
 - You can create returns orders. Note that you must use “deep insert” requests (a header plus the following entities: header partner, header pricing element, item, item partner, and item pricing element). You cannot create headers without including any related entities.
 - For existing returns orders, you can create new items. Note that you must use “deep insert” requests (with the following entities: item partner and item pricing element). You cannot create items without including any related entities.
 - For existing returns orders, you can add additional business partners at header and item levels.
 - For existing returns orders, you can update the header, header partner, header pricing element, item, item partner, and item pricing element.
 - For existing returns orders, you can delete the header, header partner, header pricing element, item, item partner, and item pricing element.

x-sap-shortText: Create, read, update, and delete returns orders for customer returns using this synchronous inbound service

values.text: [Customer Returns with Direct Shipment from Customer to Supplier (1Z3)](https://me.sap.com/processnavigator/SolP/1Z3 " Link To BP ")

x-sap-extensible.description:
If you are working with key user extensibility, the API can be extended by custom fields on the following business contexts (field usage for this API needs to be selected):
* Sales: Sales Document (SD_SALESDOC)
* Sales: Sales Document Item (SD_SALESDOCITEM)

[How to add an extension field to an API](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_CLOUD/0f69f8fb28ac4bf48d2b57b9637e81fa/ce819b8557194ae0aa180ba4ac6a04de.html)

post.description: Creates returns order headers by using deep insert requests.This means that consumers must create a header together with at least one of the following entities: header partner, header pricing element, item, item partner, and item pricing element.
